description: Scores 1–30 resumes against one job posting (ATS keyword match). Returns, per resume: match score 0–100, verdict, missing required and other keywords, missing sections, contact details present, and the top fixes. Results are sorted best first. Each resume uses 1 credit of a license key; without a key only the score is returned (max 3 resumes). Resume text is processed in memory and not stored.

job_posting.description: Full text of the job posting (responsibilities + requirements).

license_key.description: Gumroad license key of the 30-resume pack. Optional if the connector URL already has ?key=.

name.description: Candidate or file name, used to label the result.

name: check_resumes
title: Check resumes against a job posting
